key_points: Boeing attributes the year-over-year increase in net loss primarily to the absence of an income tax benefit in 2022.

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — Note 4 Income Taxes: statutory-to-actual rate reconciliation (p77)
key_points: The rate reconciliation shows the statutory federal tax at 21.0% as a negative dollar amount in loss years: ($1,054) million in FY2022 and ($1,057) million in FY2021.
The reconciliation's bottom line shows income tax expense/(benefit) of $31 million at (0.6)% for FY2022 and ($743) million at 14.7% for FY2021.

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — Other Earnings Items (p27): Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 timing
key_points: The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 was signed into law in August 2022 and contained provisions effective January 1, 2023, including a 15% corporate minimum tax and a 1% excise tax on stock buybacks.
The Company stated it does not expect the IRA provisions to have a material impact on its results of operations, financial condition or cash flows.
Because the IRA provisions take effect January 1, 2023, they are not a driver of the FY2022 effective tax rate.
